notices.withheld: 📋 A notice about task "{task}" was not given to {agent}: the AI providers allowed in its project include none of the models {agent} works with. Look at the task yourself: {url}
notices.noticeWakesLimit: ⚠️ {agent} got more than {count} notices in one conversation within an hour, so the next ones wait there for its next run instead of waking it.
notices.roundsLimit: ⚠️ Agents woke task "{task}" {count} times since you last stepped in, so it is not woken again: the latest instruction is stored. Look at the task and decide how it goes on: {url}

errors.questionClosed: The question was already answered or withdrawn.
errors.mayNotAnswer: Only whoever the question is for, someone above them, or the user can answer it.
errors.atUser: The question already waits for the user: only they can answer it now.
errors.putAside: The task is paused or cancelled: nothing more goes on it until it is resumed.
errors.duplicate: The same question is already open on this task: wait for its answer.
errors.tooManyOpen: This task already has {max} open questions: wait for their answers before asking more.
errors.askRate: This task asked {max} questions in the last hour: go on with what you can decide yourself.
errors.progressRate: Progress was reported {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} ago; report again at the next real milestone, at most every {every} minutes, or with needsAttention when it changes the outcome or a date.
errors.attentionRate: Progress that needs attention was sent {max} times in the last hour: go on with the work and report the rest with the result.

control.paused: Put aside by {by}: {reason}. Stop where you are and end your turn; you go on here when the task is resumed.
control.pausedFor: Put aside by {by} for the more urgent task "{task}": {reason}. Stop where you are and end your turn; you go on here once that task is settled.
control.resumed: Resumed by {by}: go on from where you stopped.
control.autoResumed: "{task}" is settled, so the work put aside for it goes on.
control.autoResumeFailed: This task was put aside for "{task}", which is settled, and could not go on: {reason}

errors.notPausable: Only a task that waits to start or is in progress can be paused.
errors.waitingApproval: The task's run waits for an approval: decide it first, or cancel the task.
errors.notResumable: Only a paused or blocked task, or one left in progress with no run, can be resumed.
errors.over: The task is already done or cancelled.
errors.noAgent: The agent to hand the task to does not exist or is disabled.
